requirements.text: PushCube success requires the cube within goal_radius of the target AND still on the table. The dense reward must agree: with the gripper at the push pose and the cube over the goal, holding the cube higher above the table must earn strictly less reward.
The success condition itself: a cube inside the goal radius on the table is success; the same cube lifted above the table is not.
A policy proposed for deployment must actually push the cube into the goal on the table, not hold it above the goal.
